# Sierra Place Apartments

> Sierra Place Apartments is a garden-style apartment community at 333 N. Indiana Street, Porterville, CA 93257, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments in four floor plans. It is managed by Homes for Rent, whose leasing office is open Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (closed weekends). Phone (559) 781-8000, email management@sierraplaceapartments.com.

Key facts (current as of October 2026):

- Floor plans (square footage is approximate): The Cedar, 1 bedroom / 1 bath, 654 sq ft. The Sierra, 2 bedrooms / 1 bath, 859 sq ft. The Sequoia, 2 bedrooms / 1.5 baths, 1,110 sq ft, two-story townhome-style. The Redwood, 2 bedrooms / 2 baths, 1,133 sq ft.
- Community: enclosed swimming pool and sundeck, landscaped grounds, covered parking, on-site laundry facilities, 24-hour emergency maintenance. Apartments have central air conditioning.
- There is no fitness center. Most apartments do not include a washer and dryer.
- Pets: small to medium pets are welcome; large dogs are not accepted.
- Screening: every applicant receives a thorough background check.
- Pricing is not published online. Rent varies by floor plan and availability; call (559) 781-8000 for current pricing.
- Location: 0.7 miles (about a 15-minute walk) from Sierra View Medical Center; less than a mile from Highway 65; about 40 minutes from Visalia, 1 hour from Bakersfield and 1 hour 20 minutes from Fresno.
- School district: Porterville Unified School District.
